Home News Arts and Culture Business Sports Opinion Research Live TV/Radio Media Elections Dark Mode Dark mode --> Education | National University of Ghana awaits Book and Research Allowance over documentation delay Source : Myjoyonline.com 19 October 2026 7:41pm Audio By Carbonatix
The University of Ghana is awaiting payment of its Book and Research Allowance following delays in the submission and validation of documents required for the disbursement, the Education Minister’s spokesperson, Hashmin Mohammed, has said.
In a Facebook post on Monday, October 19, 2026, Mr Mohammed explained that the institution’s documents had to be submitted to the Ghana Tertiary Education Commission (GTEC) for validation before the Controller and Accountant-General’s Department (CAGD) could process the payment.
His explanation comes as the government advances payments of the allowance to eligible tertiary institutions, with GH¢238 million reportedly disbursed to 56 institutions under the first batch.
A further GH¢198 million has been earmarked for the second batch, which includes the University of Ghana.
Mr Mohammed said the documentation and validation requirements were necessary to ensure that payments were properly processed and made to the intended institutions.
However, he did not provide a specific date for the University of Ghana’s payment.
The spokesperson said the government had mobilised approximately GH¢436 million for the allowance payments, covering the first and second batches.
The allowance supports the academic and research activities of eligible lecturers in public tertiary institutions.
The latest update provides an explanation for the delay affecting the University of Ghana, although the timing of its eventual payment remains unclear.
Attention will now be on the completion of the validation process and the release of the funds to the institution.
